IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long,
tousled brown hair and wispy bangs
stands against a plain white backdrop
with her arms crossed loosely. She
wears a fitted navy long-sleeve knit top
with a lace-trimmed scoop neckline and
a row of small buttons at the center, over
a tiered navy ruffled mini skirt. Her
expression is calm and slightly guarded.
Soft, even studio light with minimal
shadow. Palette of navy, white, and
muted charcoal. Sweet and romantic, in
the style of a coquette-inspired online
clothing catalog.
